notes.title: Update 1.6.0
notes.content:
I am showing off my game at an independent games developer's conference, so I am updating the Steam version to be the latest version of the game to make it parity with mobile. Changes include:

[list]
[*]Added 10 levels, increasing the total level count from 170 to 180
[*]Tutorial has been expanded to 15 levels.
[*]Novice has been expanded to 40 levels.
[*]Bug fixes.
[*]Texture fixes.
[*]Levels rearranged based on perceived difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: One Year Anniversary Update
notes.content:
It's a bit hard to believe that it has been a year since I released my game out into the world. There has been a lot of learning to do; but for requirements to have each build iteration have a unique number, I would have easily lost count the number of times I have made changes.

But enough about me, this update is about the game itself. Just a few of the changes that I have been working on since the last update are:
[list]
[*]Added a cold opening that puts the player right into the game if it is their first time playing.
[*]Added a new difficulty called "Tutorial".
[*]Total level count increased to 170.
[*]Level modifications here and there.
[*]Various new ball types, including Sun.
[*]A new Progress screen that shows how close the player is to unlocking a ball.
[*]Bug fixes and optimizations.
[/list]

As per usual if you notice anything odd feel free to contact me and I will work to resolve it in a new build.

notes.title: Build 1.2.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912750/1aa0f20a9754f2dd14bd4a87377ea19d4a6f18b6.png[/img]
Happy New Year, everyone! Welcome to the 2025 version of BallBastic!

[list]
[*] Water levels have been raised so that if a player fails, the amount of time before he or she can try again is reduced.
[*] Ballcoin is no longer a method by which to gain lives, and instead can be used to unlock two ball types.
[*] Added a new secret ball type. Good luck finding it!
[*] Optimizations in code for when a player wins or loses. Should be unnoticeable on stronger PCs but better fits with the mantra of the game being playable on a toaster.
[*] Renamed Turn to Inertia and increased its rotation speed to better sell the idea that your ball should not move on the platform by itself. The level previously called Inertia is now called Quick Shift.
[*] Aligned the occasional out-of-place texture.
[*] Removed freeplay mode, as unlimited lives is now the standard.
[*] Added an additional trampoline in Trampoline, as players were confused as to what the big black disc was.
[*] Reskinned slower powerups, as their color shade was too close to normal pickups and could confuse players. Now they are a shade of pink.
[*] Reduced glossiness on angled platforms facing the camera so that players are not blinded by the light.
[*] Reduced glossiness on player balls so that light reflections are less obtrusive.
[*] Some levels have been more forgiving or more challenging for better difficulty scaling.
[*] Fixed bugs of mobile-exclusive things like buttons being in the Steam version of the game.
[*] Removed shadows in specific places where it would negatively impact players.
[*] Various minor bug fixes for a smoother and more fair experience.
[*] Removed the DLC packages as they are no longer relevant. If you paid for a DLC package in the past, please email proof to phunengames@gmail.com and I will give you a refund.
[/list]

notes.title: BallBastic! is Going Paid
notes.content:
Hello all,

We have been through quite a lot together, haven't we? This is my first game I have ever put up on the Steam Store, and simply put I have had a lot of learning to do.
My initial plan for BallBastic! was to have an "arcadey" style gameplay loop to it: you would play, die, gain lives, play, die, gain more lives, play again. There would also be an option to pay to increase your maximum life count to give you more attempts each time before hitting a Game Over, while still being perfectly beatable on a single life if you were skilled enough. Simply put, this system was found by players to be frustrating, struggling to reach a level and then having a handful of attempts at their latest opponent before having to start again.

Well, no longer! I hope to, by the end of this year, implement the changes I have made to BallBastic! since I started working on the mobile version of the game, and merge it with Steam. Changes include (but are not limited to):
[list]
[*]Levels being changed to be more fair or more challenging, depending on each level.
[*]Faster loading times when a player wins, dies, or exits to the main menu.
[*]Reduced sheen on the balls and platforms to make it less obtrusive to see.
[*]New ball types.
[*]Infinite lives, unless on Survival mode.
[*]Raised water levels so if the player falls off they can get back into the action sooner.
[/list]

These changes however mean that I will be making a change to the pricing model of the game, requiring users to pay $4 and play to their hearts' content. The money will help me fund my next big endeavor.

In the meantime, enjoy the game as it currently is. If you have already downloaded the game, you will be getting the paid version for free! Isn't that lovely?

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed loading quicksave with the cannonball giving a different ball altogether.
[*]Rearranged some voicelines because of the store being removed; they are now used elsewhere.
[/list]

[h2]Ultimate Pack![/h2]
[list]
[*]The store for the game has been removed.
[*]In its place is the Ultimate Pack, which you can buy as DLC off of Steam (at the time of releasing Update 1.0.6, the Ultimate Pack is not available, but it will be very soon).
[*]It gives you the eyeball playable ball, which is pretty cool.
[*]It also unlocks Freeplay mode.
[/list]

[h2]Freeplay Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*]Gives unlimited lives; you can keep going until you win!
[*]Balls obtained from beating a difficulty can be obtained from Freeplay mode, balls that require a specific mode such as Score or Survival cannot.
[*]Freeplay results are not eligible for high scores or leaderboards.
[*]Freeplay earns ballcoin at 1/20th the rate of normal modes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug "Play for Score" button would revert to lowercase if switching from Full font.
[/list]
[h2]Pricing Changes[/h2]
[h3]To give you the boost to make it to the next level![/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed 1 ball purchase option because Steam would not allow purchases below a dollar.
[*][b]Prices have permanently slashed by 40% across the board.[/b] For instance, 6 lives are now $2.99 instead of $4.99.
[*][i][b]55 lives is reduced even further to $19.99[/b][/i], a permanent decrease of 50%, and approximately 36 cents for each increase of your maximum life counter.
[*]To keep the Starter Pack better in line with these price cuts, it now gives 7 lives and the Cannonball. This even applies retroactively to those who have bought the Starter Pack already!
[*]Changed script order so that a player will receive the seven increased starting lives from the Starter Pack even if he or she fails or refuses to claim the Cannonball.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.4

[*]Fixed a critical bug wherein if a player had enough Ballcoin to unlock a new life, the Ballcoins he or she earned from the previous game session were doubled. (Any Ballcoin you have earned due to this bug up until now is yours to keep, consider it an early arrival bonus!)
[/list]
